body: A classical portrait of Mozart with a Bitcoin coin over each eye.

title: 2020 was fine
body: Someone smiling at the camera while everything burns in the background, labelled 2020.

title: Waiting for the dip
body: Someone insisting they will buy Bitcoin at twenty thousand, a price that never comes back.

title: A difficult decision
body: The two-buttons meme, where both buttons say the same thing: buy Bitcoin.

title: Not in twenty years
body: A declaration of never letting go of Bitcoin, not now and not in twenty years.

title: Eyes elsewhere
body: The distracted-boyfriend meme: someone staring at Bitcoin while the dollar stands ignored beside them.

title: Just a few more months
body: Someone promising to hold for a few more months while everything falls apart around them.

title: Candy store money
body: A child holding Bitcoin, refusing to sell until she can buy a candy store.

title: Two kinds of investor
body: Two people side by side: one waiting to buy at zero, the other waiting for it to only go up.
